en.io: Inputs are ./my-agent/build-sheet.json, ./my-agent/goal.json, recorded status values, and existing launcher artifacts. Outputs are an inventory, a self-contained agent-overview.html, upgrade suggestions, an updated NEXT-DIRECTIONS.md expectation, and a done phase transition.
en.boundary: The workflow only reports primitives recorded in existing state and does not itself establish that external resources are live. The referenced scripts and companion phase tooling are not included in the attached evidence. It is a closeout step, not an agent creation or deployment mechanism.
dependencies: A populated ./my-agent build sheet and goal-state files
scenarios: Recap which agent, environment, session, memory, outcome, and deployment primitives exist.
Regenerate a shareable agent-overview.html after changes.
Rank recorded deferrals and standing hardening ideas.
Confirm which components are live versus only planned.
Finalize the launcher workflow's goal phase.

zh.io: 输入为 ./my-agent/build-sheet.json、./my-agent/goal.json、已记录状态值及现有启动器产物。输出为资产清单、自包含 agent-overview.html、升级建议、对 NEXT-DIRECTIONS.md 的更新要求及完成状态迁移。
zh.boundary: 该流程只报告现有状态中记录的原语，不能自行证明外部资源确已上线。所引用脚本和配套阶段工具未包含在附加证据中。它是收尾步骤，不负责创建或部署代理。
dependencies: 已填充的 ./my-agent 构建表和目标状态文件
配套的 goal_state.py 工作流
scenarios: 汇总已有的代理、环境、会话、记忆、结果和部署原语。
在发生变更后重新生成可分享的 agent-overview.html。
对已记录的延期项和常规加固建议排序。
确认哪些组件已上线，哪些仍只是计划。
完成代理启动器工作流的目标阶段。
